text: Cornered at the end of a locked stairwell by a man who is slashing at her with a knife, a woman shoves him down the stairs and he breaks his leg
A neighbour shoves a man during a garden dispute; the man, who could simply have stepped indoors and shut his door, shoves him back and the neighbour falls and is bruised
A teenager slaps a man in a queue; the man, with the street open behind him, pulls out a knife and stabs the teenager, who survives
In a dark car park a stranger walks quickly towards a woman with something in his hand, and she sprays him with pepper spray; the object was his phone
